name: Context7
what: Pulls up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples into your prompt, so the AI stops relying on outdated training data or made-up APIs.
who: Anyone coding with AI on fast-moving frameworks (Next.js, React, Supabase, etc.).

setup.text: Quickest (needs Node.js 22.13+). It signs you in with OAuth, creates an API key and sets up Cursor, Claude Code or OpenCode (--cursor / --claude / --opencode). You can choose CLI + Skills mode or MCP mode:
Manual: add the remote MCP server. An API key is recommended (not required) for higher rate limits; pass it as a Bearer header. Free keys are at context7.com/dashboard.
Add 'use context7' to a prompt (or add a rule telling your agent to always use it) to pull in fresh docs.

prompts: Create a Next.js proxy that checks for a valid JWT in cookies and redirects unauthenticated users to /login. use context7
Show me the Supabase auth API for email/password sign-up. use context7
Implement basic authentication with Supabase. use library /supabase/supabase for API and docs.
